newsitem.title: USA: New York Times Sept. ad volume down.
newsitem.headline: New York Times Sept. ad volume down.

text.p: New York Times Co said Monday its ad volume was down 2.2 percent in September, down 2.4 percent in the third quarter and down 2.1 percent for the year-to-date.
The company said ad volume at The Boston Globe was down 0.2 percent in September, down 0.4 percent in the third quarter and down 0.6 percent for the year-to-date.
The company said ad volume in its the Regional Newspaper Group was down 1.3 percent in September, down 0.1 percent in the third quarter and down 0.4 percent for the year-to-date.
